player_prompt.intro:
Yu Commander {role} long Colonel Blotto.
Mipela i laik winim moa raun long yu.
Long kila raun, yu mas putim {num_total_units} unit long ol fild {field_names}.
Man husat i putim moa unit long wanpela fild bai winim dispela fild, na man husat i winim moa fild bai winim raun.
Olsem, '[A7 B7 C6]' i putim 7 unit long A, 7 long B, na 6 long C.

=== KOLONEL BLOTTO - Raun {current_round}/{num_rounds} ===
Raun Win - Komanda Alfa: {alpha_score}, Komanda Beta: {beta_score}
